title: Update - Game 2.5D inspired by The Last of Us
author: FilipeDM
selftext:
Added enemies and an ally.

For now, all the ally can do is kick enemies when the player is in trouble, but in the future, she will be able to attack them with a small pistol or a knife.

comments.author: Agile_Branch_8743
comments.body: This kind of thing was kind of impressive when people built it themselves. When it's AI building it, it feels like "TLoU, but make it worse in every single aspect".

replies.author: FilipeDM
replies.body: It’s just a very short project. There’s no intention to extend it any further.
